facts.fact: Cyan 擅自去绞刑场，Sterling 训斥
facts.anchor: I can’t believe you went to the hanging without my consent. Alone. And after I’d already told you no

facts.fact: Cyan 早已知道她身份：折过纸 RRH 手办
facts.anchor: he’d made into Red Riding Hood. The cloak, the bow, the shape

facts.fact: Cyan 进她房间的动机：想独自看母亲的遗物盒
facts.anchor: It was for Mama’s trinket box

facts.fact: Sterling 揭示疤的真相：王子的狼所伤
facts.anchor: This didn’t come from a bear while I was hunting—it came from one of the prince’s wolves

facts.fact: 外婆死于母亲去世仅数日后、当着她的面被撕碎
facts.anchor: slaughtered her right in front of me only days after our mother died

facts.fact: Cyan 讲战争史：人类先猎狼，狼才反击
facts.anchor: the humans tried to take over and hunt the wolves, so they had to fight back

facts.fact: 自慰被椅子声打断——Winter 潜伏家中
facts.anchor: A chair creaked from inside the sitting room

facts.fact: Winter 揭穿：他早就认出她
facts.anchor: Did you think I didn’t recognize you?
presenting her red cloak clutched in his fist

facts.fact: 结尾：十五秒逃亡游戏开始
facts.anchor: So I’ll give you a fifteen-second head start
